g.title: Serves /v1/stream, /metrics and /healthz. Clients send 16-bit PCM frames, and each session holds a LiveInspector. Sessions (256 by default), utterance length, frame size and idle time are capped.
Feeds the frames to the same StreamSegmenter that batch mode uses, then scores each clip and applies the FilterPolicy. Samples are judged as received, with no loudness leveling.
A hand-written histogram tracks decision latency.
Sent back over the WebSocket once the pause that ends a clip is heard.
